nodes.label: SUIMONO_Module

nodes.description: Surface prefab can be positioned and scaled within the scene.

nodes.label: UnderwaterFX

nodes.label: Scene camera tracking
nodes.description: MainCamera tag by default; manual selection and independent Scene Track Object supported.

nodes.label: Scriptable Render Pipeline compatibility
nodes.description: Bundled March 2020 note defers HDRP and URP support pending stability. Historical vendor statement, not current compatibility evidence.

nodes.label: USV modular controller split
nodes.rationale: First-pass non-breaking split retains Assets/usv_controller.py as entrypoint.

nodes.label: config.py
nodes.description: Tunable constants and ports

nodes.label: state.py
nodes.description: Shared runtime state and thread locks

nodes.label: helpers.py
nodes.description: Common utilities and drawing helpers

nodes.label: vision.py
nodes.description: TCP camera reception and YOLO/depth/wake processing thread

nodes.label: control.py
nodes.description: Vision-based control logic and command output

nodes.label: app.py
nodes.description: Startup wiring, main loop and UI loop

nodes.label: usv.app.main()
nodes.description: Delegation target for Assets/usv_controller.py

nodes.label: Clean Hugging Face uploads
nodes.description: Prepared locally; no upload claimed.

nodes.label: Clean YOLO dataset export
nodes.description: 3178 training, 384 validation and 384 test paired image-label samples; masks, raw captures, caches and model weights excluded.

nodes.label: Starting model best_v2.pt
nodes.description: Original checkpoint before adaptation training, stored separately from dataset and future trained checkpoints.

nodes.label: Separate Hub repositories
nodes.description: Separate repositories for clean dataset and starting weights; interactive authentication.

nodes.label: Colab Hub downloads
nodes.description: snapshot_download fetches dataset; hf_hub_download fetches best_v2.pt. Clean ZIP is not a drop-in replacement for earlier combined training ZIP.

nodes.label: export_huggingface.py
nodes.description: Allowlisted export validates labels, pairing, checksums and ZIP contents; refuses nonempty destinations; does not authenticate, upload or train.

nodes.label: Unity identity-based YOLO labels
nodes.description: Camera capture runs only with -usvdataset job.json. Class IDs 0 leader and 1 follower.

nodes.label: Episode-isolated dataset splits
nodes.description: 26 episodes: 18 train, 4 validation, 4 test. All cameras from an episode remain in one split.

nodes.label: Visible mesh annotation
nodes.description: Unlit non-antialiased identity mask with depth testing against opaque geometry and ocean; boxes enclose visible mesh pixels.

nodes.label: Through-spray annotation policy
nodes.description: Transparent spray excluded as hard-mask occluder; hull labels remain behind spray; foam and spray excluded from boat boxes.
nodes.rationale: Transparent occlusion is not claimed to be perfectly measured.

nodes.label: Small-instance filtering
nodes.description: Ignore objects below 16 visible mask pixels or a three-pixel box side. Annotate visible pieces of camera-owning vessel.

nodes.label: Legacy data mixing
nodes.description: Legacy manual training images copied with legacy_train_ prefix; original validation held separately because episode grouping is unknown.

nodes.label: Cross-split deduplication
nodes.description: Remove exact image-file duplicates across prepared splits, giving new validation/test frames priority.

nodes.label: Empty background crops
nodes.description: Training sky/water crops verified to have zero boat-mask pixels; validation/test use full frames.

nodes.label: Fine-tuning from best_v2.pt
nodes.description: 640-pixel input, maximum 50 epochs, early stopping, AdamW, learning rate 0.001. Original checkpoint retained.

nodes.label: Colab checkpoint resumption
nodes.description: Batch 8, local image extraction, Drive checkpoints/logs; resumes last.pt and detects completed checkpoints.

nodes.label: Held-out model evaluation
nodes.description: Select training settings on validation, evaluate test once selected, separately evaluate legacy validation and actual formation-controller behavior.

nodes.label: Isolated Unity capture project
nodes.description: Copies Assets, Packages, ProjectSettings and import cache, builds Linux player; private UDP listeners and no camera stream avoid editor/controller interference.

nodes.label: Diagnostic follower controller
nodes.description: Follower motion independent of YOLO during capture.
nodes.rationale: Bad detections cannot prevent useful adaptation example collection.

nodes.label: Capture resumption safeguards
nodes.description: --resume --no-build skips completed episodes with unchanged plan; rejects partial overwrite and plan changes in existing output.

nodes.label: Portable prepared dataset
nodes.description: YAML paths relative to their file; prepared images/labels usable independently from raw captures.
